python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Actual values (in thousands of dollars)
fy2010 = 200209720
fy2015 = 269716999
fy2024_actual = 384447300

# Calculate CAGR from FY 2010 to FY 2015
# CAGR = (Ending Value / Beginning Value)^(1/n) - 1
ratio = fy2015 / fy2010
print(f"Ratio (FY2015/FY2010): {ratio}")

n = 5  # years from 2010 to 2015
cagr = ratio ** (1/n) - 1
print(f"CAGR (2010-2015): {cagr}")
print(f"CAGR percentage: {cagr * 100:.4f}%")

# Calculate projected FY 2024 value
# Using FY 2015 as base year, projecting 9 years forward (2015 to 2024)
years = 9  # from FY 2015 to FY 2024
fy2024_projected = fy2015 * ((1 + cagr) ** years)
print(f"\nProjected FY 2024: {fy2024_projected}")
print(f"Actual FY 2024: {fy2024_actual}")

# Calculate percentage difference relative to actual
# (Projected - Actual) / Actual * 100
pct_diff = ((fy2024_projected - fy2024_actual) / fy2024_actual) * 100
print(f"\nPercentage difference: {pct_diff:.2f}%")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {round(pct_diff, 2)}%")
EOF
